lines.en: Feasting on human flesh, unmatched pleasure.

lines.zh: 队服上的扣子，我扣好了。
lines.en: My uniform is buttoned; I am ready.
Phantom shadows, die in the dark.
Blade at my hip, I patrol this street.

lines.zh: 刀在腰间，我走进夜色里。
lines.en: Blade at my hip, I walk into the night.

lines.zh: 靴底踩着湿叶，我赶往下一处。
lines.en: Boots on wet leaves, I head for the next site.

lines.zh: 孤独的灵魂，无尽的战斗！

lines.en: Wait for prey, patience like death.
Watch and wait, prey will come.

lines.zh: 鬼的味道，从这条巷子来。
lines.en: A demon's scent comes down this alley.
Player's scent, wait for the right moment.

lines.zh: 皮肉焦了，我还是要往前。
lines.en: My flesh is scorched, and I still push on.

lines.zh: 血糊住眼睛，我还站得住。
lines.en: Blood seals my eyes, and I still stand.

lines.zh: 血鬼术打穿了我的护甲。
lines.en: A blood art punched through my armor.

lines.zh: 这一下太重，我跪了下去。
lines.en: That hit was heavy; I drop to one knee.

lines.zh: 肚子挨了一下，饿得更凶。
lines.en: A blow to my gut leaves me hungrier.

lines.zh: 诱人的人肉香味，让我难以自持！
lines.en: The smell of human meat is too tempting!

lines.zh: 分我一口饭团，我就跟上你。
lines.en: Give me a bite of rice ball and I will follow.

lines.zh: 快点给我点吃的，不然我生气了！
lines.en: Give me some food or I'll be angry!
This is my food, don't steal it!

lines.zh: 你闻到了吗？人肉的味道！
lines.en: Can you smell it? Human meat!
Your scabbard swings at your belt.
I hit you, are you okay?
I hit you, get out of the way!

lines.zh: 并肩站着，刀才不会卷刃。
lines.en: Stand shoulder to shoulder, and our blades stay keen.
Snarl and gnaw at the corpse.
Delicious, this makes a good meal.
This is my food, enjoy it.
This is my prey, enjoy it.
I pick up a broken blade; its grain is still fresh.
Where's the prey? I'll eat it.

lines.zh: 感受到猎物的气味，接近！
闻到血腥味了，鬼就在前面。
lines.en: I smell blood; the demon is ahead.

lines.zh: 队士三人一队，正好合围。
lines.en: Three of us make a fine surround.
I will cut this demon tonight.

lines.zh: 你吃了多少人，我都记着。
lines.en: I remember how many you have eaten.

lines.zh: 日轮刀出鞘，你无路可退。
lines.en: My blade is drawn; you have no way back.

lines.zh: 日轮刀出鞘，鬼就在前面。
lines.en: My nichirin blade is out; the demon is ahead.
Demon, draw your blade; I count to three.
Cut its limbs first, then the neck.
Slow the breath, steady the edge.

lines.zh: 它一动，我便知道破绽在哪。
lines.en: One move and I know the opening.

lines.zh: 脚跟稳住，站住这片地面。
lines.en: Set the heel; hold this ground.

lines.zh: 它扑来的方向，我已算好。
lines.en: I have worked out where it will leap.

lines.zh: 刀身压低，等它自己送上来。
lines.en: Blade low; let it come to me.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，鬼的速度比风快。
lines.en: Do not blink; demons outrun the wind.

lines.zh: 队士之间，留出一个身位。
lines.en: Leave a body's width between us.
I draw my breath down to a thread.
One horizontal slash severs its neck.

lines.zh: 你的生命就是我的养料！

lines.en: You can’t escape, not even the bones!
Souls of the demons, belong to me!

lines.zh: 你将化为尘土，消失不见！
lines.en: You will turn to dust and vanish!

lines.zh: 一刀斜劈，血色溅上树皮。
lines.en: A diagonal cut; blood sprays the bark.

lines.zh: 刀背狠狠砸在它的肩上。
lines.en: The flat of my blade slams its shoulder.
I sever the arm that reached for me.
My edge grows hot; demon blood steams.
It retreats, and my blade follows.
I catch its fangs on my guard.
This cut is for the fallen of the corps.

lines.zh: 队服还没干，我就上路了。
lines.en: My uniform was still wet when I set out.
In this darkness, I am the light!

lines.zh: 我从死里重生，永不衰败！
lines.en: Born from death, I never fade!

lines.zh: 恶鬼们，准备好迎接死亡吧！
lines.en: Demons, prepare to meet your death!

lines.zh: 我就是正义与复仇的化身！
lines.en: I am the avatar of justice and revenge!

lines.zh: 这里不是你该来的世界！
lines.en: This isn’t your world to be in!

lines.zh: 你将被囚禁在永恒的黑夜！
lines.en: You will be imprisoned in eternal night!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队巡查至此，报上名来。
lines.en: The corps patrols here. Name yourself.
Three of us come down the mountain road.

lines.zh: 队服上还沾着昨夜的灰。
lines.en: My uniform still holds last night's ash.
I was sent to clear this district.
My sleeve is burning. Beat it out.

lines.zh: 我从屋檐上摔下来，刀还在手。
lines.en: I fall from the eaves, blade still in hand.
River water is up my nose.

lines.zh: 爆炸的碎片划开我的袖口。
箭钉进我的肩，我咬着牙。
lines.en: An arrow pins my shoulder; I grit my teeth.

lines.zh: 血鬼术扫过来，我退了半步。
lines.en: A blood art sweeps in and I give half a step.

lines.zh: 两天没吃饭，握刀的手在抖。
lines.en: Two days without food; my grip trembles.
